title: MIT Open Learning discussion report joined platform codes to display names
evidence: The merged Superset dataset patch replaces a course-run lookup whose platform uses display names with a dimensional lookup whose platform uses codes. The PR reports that the mismatched inner join caused the chart to return no rows.
source_sql:
select
    de.platform,
    cr.course_title,
    de.courserun_readable_id,
    de.event_type,
    de.post_title,
    de.post_content,
    de.discussion_component_name,
    de.page_url,
    de.event_timestamp
from ol_warehouse_production_dimensional.tfact_discussion_events as de
inner join ol_warehouse_production_intermediate.int__combined__course_runs as cr
    on de.courserun_readable_id = cr.courserun_readable_id
    and de.platform = cr.platform
adaptation: The saved before SQL is the complete YAML block with standard YAML indentation removed. The replay adds the id projection. Its fixed query references a fixture view implementing the dimensional title lookup from the merged SQL. The original schema and table names resolve to synthetic DuckDB tables.
before_sql:
select
    de.courserun_readable_id AS id,
    de.platform,
    cr.course_title,
    de.courserun_readable_id,
    de.event_type,
    de.post_title,
    de.post_content,
    de.discussion_component_name,
    de.page_url,
    de.event_timestamp
from ol_warehouse_production_dimensional.tfact_discussion_events as de
inner join ol_warehouse_production_intermediate.int__combined__course_runs as cr
    on de.courserun_readable_id = cr.courserun_readable_id
    and de.platform = cr.platform
after_sql:
select
    de.courserun_readable_id AS id,
    de.platform,
    ct.course_title,
    de.courserun_readable_id,
    de.event_type,
    de.post_title,
    de.post_content,
    de.discussion_component_name,
    de.page_url,
    de.event_timestamp
from ol_warehouse_production_dimensional.tfact_discussion_events as de
inner join course_titles as ct
    on de.courserun_readable_id = ct.courserun_readable_id
    and de.platform = ct.platform
